body.name: Factor-recovered actual-row support and closure
body.construction: Choose any representative of \(\mathcal R\). For each aligned target \(k\), solve the rank-one update \(A^{(k)}=A^{(0)}+a_kh_{\mathcal R,k}^{\mathsf T}\) with \(h_{\mathcal R,kk}=0\), and form \(H_{\mathcal R}\) from these rows. Define \(\mathcal C(\mathcal R)\) by \(i\to k\in\mathcal C(\mathcal R)\Longleftrightarrow(H_{\mathcal R})_{ki}\ne0\).
